extract_gps_coordinates: use the EXIF class to extract longitude and latitude from an image file's GPS EXIF tags
extract_focal_length: use the EXIF class to extract the 35mm equivalent focal length and focal ratio from image EXIF data
extract_capture_time: use the EXIF class to extract the capture timestamp as a Unix epoch float from image EXIF tags
extract_geolocation: use the EXIF class extract_geo method to get a dict with latitude, longitude, altitude, and DOP from an image
compute_focal_ratio: use the compute_focal function to calculate the 35mm focal length and focal ratio from sensor width and focal data
